customer_message.subject: chat – landlord says they will end my lease
customer_message.body:
Hannah Mehta: hi, I rent a 4-room flat at Ahornweg 97 in Wettingen from Stiftung Wohnen Zentral
Hannah Mehta: at the tenants' meeting yesterday the Stiftung's representative said they are selling the building and that "all leases will be terminated by October next year"
Hannah Mehta: I have NOT received any termination, no letter, no form, nothing in writing. it was only said at the meeting
Hannah Mehta: I'm not worried about having time to move out, I'm moving abroad for work in spring anyway, so that's not the point
Hannah Mehta: I just want to know if they can actually do this and what I should do now, before anything arrives
